opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers, resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports experienced researchers to complete a piece of original research, up to £70,000, fellowship duration 3-24 months.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: up to £56,000 in year one and £28,000 in years two and three, plus up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post, hold a doctorate, and meet specific post‑doctoral experience criteria.
opportunities.summary: Provides salary contribution (up to £56k year 1, £28k years 2‑3) and research expenses up to £6k per year for a 3‑year fellowship.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities or eligible UK higher‑education institutions; applicants must be employed by the institution and have institutional approval.
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative research projects up to £500,000 for up to five years; requires ≥75% of budget for research staff costs.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university staff (or specialist arts institutions) responsible for coordinating the visit; must be based at a UK university with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Funds visits by eminent overseas scholars (3–12 months) to enhance skills and knowledge; awards between £10k and £150k.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment (lecturer level) or nominated by a UK university; must have ≤2 years post‑PhD experience and not have led a research team before.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build a modest research team for 4‑5 years, up to £1 million.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million total; individual scholarships up to £10,000 per year for students, plus additional funding for under‑represented groups.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers (or consortia of up to two universities) may apply; scholarships are for doctoral students, with additional provisions for under‑represented groups.
opportunities.summary: Provides doctoral scholarships (up to £10k per year) and related funding for up to 30 doctoral places per institution, plus post‑doctoral and cohort‑building support.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary costs plus up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers employed at a UK university with research degree awarding powers; not required to be of professorial rank.
opportunities.summary: Supports distinguished researchers to complete a piece of original research (2–3 year fellowship), covering salary and up to £6k/year for research expenses.

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers with a permanent UK university post (or long‑term fellowship) and a doctorate awarded ≤10 years before the deadline.
opportunities.summary: Award of £100k (2–3 year funding) to individuals for research purposes across rotating subject areas.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering fine/performing arts training to school‑age children (under 18).
opportunities.summary: Funds arts training for school‑age students outside regular school hours; awards up to £475k per institution, duration three years starting 1 Sept 2025.
discipline_tags: Arts (music, drama, dance, film, fine art)

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Undergraduate & Postgraduate Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts institutions or charities offering undergraduate/postgraduate programmes; not university departments.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries of £5‑10k per student per year for up to three years, total award up to £475,000 per institution.
discipline_tags: Arts (music, drama, dance, film, fine art)

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired UK university researchers (or eligible independent research institutes) who have a UK residence of ≥26 weeks and have retired from a permanent post.
opportunities.summary: Supports retired senior researchers to complete a research project (3–24 months) with awards between £3k and £24k.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (with research degree awarding powers) – single or collaborative centres; consortia permitted.
opportunities.summary: Large‑scale, multi‑disciplinary research centres aiming for transformative research; up to £10 million over up to ten years.
